title: Protected readonly ods 001
notes: real ODF sheet protection at cell granularity: the table:table (table:name Locked) carries table:protected="true" and one cell opts back in to editing with table:protect="false" (ODF 1.2 §9.4: table:protect toggles protection of a single cell inside a protected table). No table:protection-key digest or digest-algorithm attribute is emitted — the fixture is password-less by design. Honest caveats: ODF sheet protection is advisory and renderer-policy — LibreOffice will open the sheet flagged protected but, without a protection-key, unprotecting needs no password; whether a render engine honors table:protected at all, and its tolerance of a boolean-only protected flag without key attributes, is UNVERIFIED (LibreOffice is not run in this environment). Reference text is the four cell strings; the normative counter reads table:table=1.
